name: Teardrop trailer
definition: small towed living trailer with a teardrop profile, a sleeping cabin and a rear-hatch galley, without standing room inside.
reason: RV dealers list teardrops as their own type; no standing interior, so not a touring caravan; folding camper does not fold.

name: Stroller wagon
definition: wheeled box-bodied carrier with harnessed seats for two or more children, pushed like a stroller or pulled by a handle.
reason: Box body with facing seats differs from a double stroller; sold as its own type (Wonderfold, Keenz).

name: Flats and bay boat
definition: shallow-draft open saltwater fishing boat with a poling or casting platform, made for bays and tidal flats.
reason: Shops list bay and flats boats apart from offshore sport-fishing and bass boats; shallow-draft inshore form.

name: River raft
definition: inflatable open boat of large tubes, paddled or rowed by a group, made for whitewater rivers.
reason: A distinct tube-boat hull sold as rafts; inflatable kayaks stay kayaks (G-8).

name: Paramotor (powered paraglider)
definition: backpack engine and propeller worn by a foot-launched pilot under a paraglider wing.
reason: Foot-launched, no cart, so not a powered parachute; motor makes it G1 (P1 logic), as unpowered paragliders are E2.
